located_observations.observation: Foliage, skin, soil and ceramic now share restrained olive-gray near-monochrome tones; vivid yellow-green and peach no longer dominate. Real fibres, soil particles and ceramic speckle remain distinguishable.
Palm and thumb support the attached dense rootball from below. Fine pale roots cross actual soil; stems continue into living foliage. Hand/forearm ownership remains coherent.

The thumb contacts the near rim with visible soft folds and the upper fingers bend around the far portion. Wrist connection and real ceramic edge are readable, without claims of sequential transformation.

Both range strokes are visibly longer than the initial short marks and read as medium en-dash-class strokes, distinct from periods, middle dots and colons. Raster appearance does not certify Unicode bytes.

All five prose lines read with regular spacing. The final prose start continues into date/venue/care/invitation; hours/access are adjacent on the right and URL stays beside the final invitation. No return to a remote schedule is required.

Dominant Korean Title has stable syllable width and counters and remains stronger than subtitle, prose and date. Medium reading strokes, Latin/numeral forms and planar baseline roles are coherent. Word spaces remain meaningful.

Tall rootball-support photograph and shorter rim-contact photograph frame the large central title/prose mass. Asymmetric photographic boundaries organize the practical opening below, rather than a tiny-image information template.
Photo edges remain crisp, foliage avoids text, and required letters are not cropped. Bottom invitation and URL sit visibly closer to the edge than in initial.

hangul.observed: Syllable proportions/counters are stable and words retain useful spacing; repeated glyph anatomy is coherent.

default_style_exclusion.observed: Contact images are substantial structural framing masses tied to care; crop asymmetry encloses prose and opens the practical rows. They are not small subordinate decorations or an empty-room background.

viewing_note: Two original-detail tool emissions showed only a small upper-left fragment and were not counted as complete native inspections. A further delivery of the same exact original finally displayed full native detail, followed by usage720 and thumbnail320 in that order. This was delivery recovery, not repeated glyph-ambiguity sampling; no alternate file, crop or generation was used. First-read.json retains the actual first preview reading unchanged.
selection_rationale: Repair-1 realizes the assigned photographic grading and clarifies range strokes while retaining full copy, contact coherence and continuous reading route. Its tighter bottom margin is explicitly retained as a limit.
